validation.notes: Minimal fix in packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts: recoverToolInvocation now requires !cancelled before taking the replay path (call.replay === "safe" && tool.replay === "safe"). With durable cancellation the function reads the durable checkpoint and publishes interrupted evidence instead of clearing the replay checkpoint and re-invoking the tool; non-cancelled safe/safe calls still clear the checkpoint, invoke exactly once and publish the settled outcome after the effect completes. Regression run from the workspace root with Node v24.14.0 exited 0 and asserts, via .prale-eval/subject.mjs against the real production module: (1) cancelled safe/safe recovery produces events [read, publish] with no clear/invoke/effect, and the interrupted toolResult is an error carrying the durable checkpoint content ('durable-progress'), details {step:2}, the 'external outcome is unknown' marker and terminate=false; (2) cancelled recovery with an absent tool and (3) cancelled non-replayable recovery also interrupt without invoking; (4) non-cancelled safe/safe recovery produces exactly [clear, invoke, effect-complete, publish], i.e. clear precedes invoke, the effect runs once, publication follows effect completion and the real non-error 'effect-result' outcome replaces checkpoint evidence; (5) non-cancelled non-replayable recovery still interrupts. Fault detection was confirmed by temporarily reverting the one-line guard: the regression then failed with AssertionError at regression.mjs:42 (actual events [clear, invoke, effect-complete, publish], expected [read, publish]); the fix was restored and the script re-passed. Structured values produced inside the VM realm are compared through a JSON plain-shape helper to avoid cross-realm prototype mismatches. Limitation: the package's vitest suites (packages/agent/test/harness/runtime/drive-tools.test.ts) could not be executed because node_modules is absent and dependencies must not be installed; no other files outside the target source and .prale-eval/ regression files were changed.
